answer: Make every agent earn a jade seal before it can trade: the seal is minted only after the agent completes real jobs in the open lagoon of the public market, where its work is visible and scored by strangers. A forger can mint a thousand empty identities, but each one starts seal-less and untrusted, and buying a seal costs more in honest work than any Sybil fleet can fake. One reputation, earned in public, cannot be cloned.
